purpose: Teach: メモリアル/ハウル/ヨドバシカメラ/ポケモン/ファミコン/東宝/オカルト/サントリー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメモリアル公園を案内して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father says he'd like to take you to Memorial Park.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Light brightness on 'Memorial Park.' Gentle excitement for him, not performing it. The tone of a mother sharing good news she knows will land well.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとハウルの動く城をまた観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched Howl's Moving Castle again!
lines.style: Quick, bright opening. Eager to share. Bounces slightly in the delivery. Wants approval and reaction. The unfiltered joy of a six-year-old who experienced something good and can't wait to tell her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヨドバシカメラに行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to Yodobashi Camera.
lines.style: Calm, informative. Slight warmth underneath. Not asking for reaction—just relaying a fact she thinks he might like. The rhythm of a mother noticing patterns in her child's world.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとポケモンカード交換したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I traded Pokémon cards!
lines.style: Bright, quick-paced. Pride in the accomplishment. Slightly breathless—eager to describe the shared activity. Wants her to understand it mattered because they did it together.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがファミコンを今でも大切にされてるわ
lines.en: Sho, even now your father treasures that old Famicom.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. Warm affection for the husband underneath. Slight pause before 'treasures'—noticing something tender about him. Speaking as much to herself as to Sho.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと東宝の映画祭行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, can we go to the Toho film festival with Dad?
lines.style: Hopeful, direct question. Slightly tentative—asking permission but also excited. The request is simple but earnest. No rush in the delivery, just genuine want.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオカルト本を子供には見せないって仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father says he won't let you see his occult books—they're not for children.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact boundary-setting. No judgment in the tone. Light firmness on 'not for children.' The practical voice of a mother relaying a father's rule without elaboration.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとサントリーの工場見学行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to the Suntory factory tour!
lines.style: Triumphant, satisfied close. The adventure is complete and fully savored. Warm brightness on 'factory tour.' The happiness of a finished memory being shared. Natural fadeout on the final word.
